description:
About Directive

Directive Consulting is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: Performance, Communications, and Commerce, each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, DiscoverabilityOS™, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and Content Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

 
 

Role Summary

We're looking for an Associate Director, Marketing Science to own how we measure what our clients' marketing actually produces. You'll wear two hats. In one you build: the marketing mix models and incrementality tests that show what marketing contributes to pipeline and revenue. In the other you translate: turning those results into budget decisions that marketing leaders and their finance teams will act on.

You'll do this hands-on for a set of our largest B2B clients, owning Revenue Narrative for each. Revenue Narrative is our monthly account story: what happened, what the model says marketing is producing, and where the next dollar should go, backed by quarterly incrementality tests. It is an honest read of the evidence that gets sharper every month, never a claim of proof the data can't support.

You start as an individual contributor, building models yourself and working side by side with our data, ML and platform engineers, who build the pipelines and the views clients see in Stratos, our client platform. Account directors lead the client conversation. You make sure every number in it is right and can be traced to its source. As the practice grows, so does the role.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

Shape the data

  • Assess each client's CRM, tracking and marketing data and decide what can be measured now, what can be measured later, and what has to be fixed first.

  • Choose the outcome each model predicts: the deepest stage with enough steady volume for marketing to move it, defined once and confirmed with the client's operations team.

  • Direct tracking and CRM fixes with our implementation resources: conversion tracking, UTM and click ID capture, lead source fields, stage definitions and integrations. Confirm each fix worked before the data is trusted.

  • Keep models consistent on imperfect history, such as definition changes, broken tracking and undated events.

Build the product

  • Build and refine a Bayesian marketing mix model for each client (we use Google Meridian), including priors, calibration from test results, diagnostics and back tests on data the model never saw.

  • Turn each model into scenario guidance: where the next dollar should go, given diminishing returns and channel limits.

  • Design quarterly incrementality tests suited to B2B, such as target-account holdouts, geo splits, budget step-ups and platform lift studies. Size each against break-even, agree in advance what each result will trigger, and read results honestly, including inconclusive ones.

  • Predict each test before it runs and feed the result back in, so the model's ranges narrow over time.

  • Work with our engineers so the method ships in the product instead of living in your notebooks.

  • Use AI tools daily to go faster and deeper, check every output before it reaches a client, and protect client data in every tool.

Deliver to clients

  • Write the monthly Revenue Narrative and present it with the account director, in language a marketing leader or a CFO can act on.

  • Read test results out at the quarterly review, and agree the testing roadmap with the channel teams.

  • Say plainly what a model can and can't support, including when a result is inconclusive or a requested number can't be backed.

  • Document decisions and trade-offs, and hold the review standard for anything that reaches a client.

  • Help win and expand large accounts by explaining how we measure impact, and coach account and channel teams in using measurement well.

What You Offer

Experience

  • Substantial experience in marketing science, analytics or data science at an agency, consultancy or growth-focused business, including measurement you owned that changed a budget decision.

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining marketing mix models yourself (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing or similar), not only using a vendor's tool or managing someone who did. You'll keep building them here.

  • Experience designing and reading incrementality tests, including power analysis and decision rules agreed in advance.

  • Experience measuring B2B outcomes from a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), with long sales cycles and low weekly volumes.

  • Experience directing tracking and CRM implementation work, and some management experience: a small team, mentoring or directing specialists. It doesn't need to be extensive.

Skills

  • Strong Python and SQL, with experience shaping weekly data from ad platforms, CRM and web analytics. BigQuery, dbt or a cloud ML platform (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of web tracking and CRM setup (Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, Salesforce or HubSpot), enough to direct and review the work.

  • AI-forward: you use AI tools and agents daily, judge their output independently, and have ideas for what to build with them. You can point to complex data you turned into a deliverable that changed a client's or an executive's decision.

How you work

  • You think about the whole funnel and the whole budget, not one channel at a time.

  • You tell a clear story, and you're comfortable telling an executive when the data can't support the answer they want.

  • You ask good questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and can manage measurement across several clients at once.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you take ownership of measurement for one large client. You assess its data and CRM readiness, agree its outcome with the client's operations team, set the first tracking and CRM fixes in motion, build the model, and deliver the first monthly Revenue Narrative in Stratos with the account director. You've also proposed a first incrementality test and agreed the testing roadmap with the channel teams.

By six months, you own measurement for several of our largest clients. Each gets a monthly Revenue Narrative that is better than anything they've had before, and better every month, plus scenario guidance on where spend should move and quarterly tests read out at the quarterly review. You predict each test before it runs, and the model's ranges narrow as results come in. Fixes land at a steady pace, and account directors walk into any room with numbers they can trace to the source. You're helping shape our measurement standards and how we talk about measurement with prospects.

What We Offer:

  • 🏠 We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in Canada is $110,000 to $140,000 base CAD with potential for bonus eligibility. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.

  • 🙏 Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

    • Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents (US, CAD, MX)

  • Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

    • 🧠 Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace

    • 💪 Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care

    • 🛫 Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave

    • 💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match

    • 🌟 Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

    • 🌴 Annual Company-wide Retreat

Work Environment Requirements

As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from your home office. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.

This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

Additional Information

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We’re committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
